theorem: For nonconstant complex polynomial F and real nonzero lambda, an autonomous real C2 field-only conservation law is nonconstant iff F=A*(w-w0)**n. Modulo constants its density is |z|**2+|w-w0|**2/(lambda*n), and flux is the difference. Positive definite iff lambda>0.
positive_even_power_theorem: F=w**(2*m),lambda>0: all bounded smooth finite weighted-charge phase-plane data with bounded derivatives are globally complete both ways, including zeros; fixed-support complex neighborhoods also scatter.
actual_sextic: F=w**4,lambda=1/4: only mass and its flux modulo constants.
bad_sign_control: F=w**n,lambda=-1/n: z=exp(i*pi/4)*r,w=r,r=(r0**(-n)-2*n*t)**(-1/n). Changed system, not a blowup of the actual positive coupling.
concentration: z=exp(i*pi/4)*A*phi(A**2*x),w=A*phi(A**2*x): fixed mass, J=0 and derivative integral zero, supremum grows as A. No mass/current-only amplitude bound.
scope: Written proof covers all C2 field-only laws and all nonconstant polynomials; finite exact censuses are controls, not the universal proof. Original arbitrary-phase large-data existence open.
